Lean Quiet's app data (assets/): where each file comes from
============================================================

tools/fetch_assets.sh (online) and tools/noto_assets.sh (offline) make
assets/ from the sources below; make install downloads the same files as
one tarball (tools/make/assets.pin). Each licence text named here is in
a LICENSE-*.txt file beside this one, copied unchanged from the source at
the version given. tools/noto_assets.sh copies this NOTICE.txt and the
licence files into assets/, so every build and release carries them.


font.bin
  The bitmap font. tools/font.py builds it from GNU Unifont 18.0.01:
  https://ftp.gnu.org/gnu/unifont/unifont-18.0.01/unifont_all-18.0.01.hex.gz
  (sha256 14c96e497466a82e46cf20032ce510e186bdc8658c9158e2290f452cda9bc498).
  Licence: Unifont's glyphs are dual-licensed under the SIL Open Font
  License 1.1 and the GNU GPL version 2 or later with the GNU font
  embedding exception; its jiskan16 glyphs are in the public domain.
  LICENSE-Unifont-COPYING.txt and LICENSE-Unifont-OFL-1.1.txt are COPYING
  and OFL-1.1.txt from unifont-18.0.01.tar.gz (same folder; sha256
  eab60847aac34c8768765cecc7821faf50de2636187b452b9b5fa50a12b00bc3).
  font.bin is distributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.

emoji.bin
  The colour emoji. tools/emoji.py (fontTools 4.68.0) takes each emoji's
  own bitmap, scaled to 48 px, from Noto Color Emoji 2.051:
  https://github.com/googlefonts/noto-emoji/raw/v2.051/fonts/NotoColorEmoji.ttf
  (sha256 72a635cb3d2f3524c51620cdde406b217204e8a6a06c6a096ff8ed4b5fd6e27b;
  "Copyright 2022 Google Inc."), for the emoji Unicode 16.0.0 lists in
  https://www.unicode.org/Public/16.0.0/ucd/emoji/emoji-data.txt
  (sha256 f1365a5173eee18e1f98b240cdc492e84a25f1ce7e0c9d1094eb29c41a22696a).
  Licence: the font, SIL Open Font License 1.1 (LICENSE-NotoColorEmoji-OFL.txt,
  fonts/LICENSE at tag v2.051); emoji-data.txt, the Unicode License v3
  (LICENSE-Unicode-v3.txt, https://www.unicode.org/license.txt, which
  https://www.unicode.org/terms_of_use.html applies to Unicode Data Files).

picker.txt
  The reaction picker's catalogue. tools/picker.py converts
  app/src/emoji-data.json of TryQuiet/libquiet at commit 38a909706
  (pinned as tools/third_party/picker.txt). libquiet's
  app/scripts/emoji.mjs writes that file from emojibase-data 17.0.0
  (en/data.json; Emoji 17, CLDR 48), keeping emoji up to Emoji 14 and
  dropping components; the labels, tags and groups are emojibase's.
  Licence: emojibase-data, the MIT License, Copyright (c) 2017-2019
  Miles Johnson (LICENSE-emojibase-data-MIT.txt, the LICENSE of the npm
  package emojibase-data 17.0.0); its labels and tags are Unicode CLDR 48
  annotations, under the Unicode License v3 (LICENSE-Unicode-v3.txt).

NotoSans-Regular.ttf, NotoSansArabic-Regular.ttf, NotoSansArmenian-Regular.ttf,
NotoSansCanadianAboriginal-Regular.ttf, NotoSansCherokee-Regular.ttf,
NotoSansEthiopic-Regular.ttf, NotoSansGeorgian-Regular.ttf,
NotoSansHebrew-Regular.ttf, NotoSansThai-Regular.ttf
  Unchanged copies of the Noto fonts in Ubuntu's fonts-noto-core
  20201225-2build1 (/usr/share/fonts/truetype/noto; Noto as of
  2020-12-25, https://github.com/googlefonts/noto-fonts), pinned by
  sha256 in tools/noto.sha256.
  Licence: SIL Open Font License 1.1, Copyright 2010,2012-2020 Google Inc.;
  2015-2020 Google LLC (NOTO-LICENSE.txt; LICENSE-fonts-noto-core-copyright.txt
  is the package's copyright file).

NotoSans-UI-Medium.ttf
  The interface face: Noto Sans 2.015's weight-500 instance, made by
  tools/ui_fonts.py --regenerate (fontTools 4.68.0) from the variable
  noto-sans-latin.woff2 that TryQuiet/libquiet bundles
  (app/src/design/fonts/ at commit bd9d9a01), which is Fontsource 5.3.0's
  @fontsource-variable/noto-sans; checked in as
  ui/fonts/NotoSans-UI-Medium.ttf.
  Licence: SIL Open Font License 1.1, Copyright 2022 The Noto Project
  Authors (LICENSE-NotoSans-Fontsource-OFL.txt, the LICENSE of the npm
  package @fontsource-variable/noto-sans 5.3.0).

NotoSansSC-Common.ttf, NotoSansTC-Common.ttf, NotoSansJP-Common.ttf,
NotoSansKR-Common.ttf
  Chinese, Japanese and Korean: tools/cjk_subset.py (fontTools 4.68.0)
  instances Regular (400) and keeps the common characters of
  NotoSans{SC,TC,JP,KR}[wght].ttf from Google Fonts, github.com/google/fonts
  at commit 9b59ea9f333c5b8a99fa44e2a698496d6cde5b8e (URLs and sha256 in
  tools/cjk_fonts.tsv; upstream https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk).
  Licence: SIL Open Font License 1.1, Copyright 2014-2021 Adobe, with
  Reserved Font Name 'Source' (LICENSE-NotoSansCJK-OFL.txt, ofl/notosanssc/OFL.txt
  at that commit; the four fonts' OFL.txt files are identical).

noto-index.bin, noto-ui-index.bin
  Character and width indexes of the fonts above, made by
  tools/noto_index.py and tools/ui_fonts.py; under those fonts' licences.

ui-glyphs.bin
  The interface icons, rendered by tools/glyph_assets.py (librsvg, Cairo)
  from ui/glyphs/*.svg: TryQuiet/libquiet's icon paths (app/src/icons.ts
  and app/src/Glyph.svelte at commit bd9d9a010062ab59a0ab0fc67731d827dd02fe27)
  and the Quiet mark (app/src/brand/quiet.json at ab3d244cfb99), see
  ui/glyphs/SOURCE.txt. The Quiet name and mark are TryQuiet's.
  Licence: LIBQUIET_LICENCE_PENDING

ui-glyphs.sha256, noto-ui.sha256
  Build stamps: digests of the scripts and sources that made ui-glyphs.bin
  and noto-ui-index.bin. No content of their own.

0.qoi to 5.qoi
  The sample photos the demo and the chaos generator send. tools/photos.py
  (Pillow 12.1.1) scales each original, pinned by sha256 in
  tools/photos.tsv, to fit the box given there and writes it as QOI.
  0.qoi  "Young tabby cat keeping watch", by W.carter.
         Page: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Young_tabby_cat_keeping_watch.jpg
         File: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/9/95/Young_tabby_cat_keeping_watch.jpg
         sha256 39512ca0b6dc81ed04a7900f8ea1bf3ce40004f276b75df301fb89ea60b240c6
         Licence: CC0 1.0, the author's own work (LICENSE-CC0-1.0.txt).
  1.qoi  "Under the Wave off Kanagawa (The Great Wave)", Katsushika Hokusai,
         ca. 1830-32; The Metropolitan Museum of Art, JP1847, H. O. Havemeyer
         Collection, Bequest of Mrs. H. O. Havemeyer, 1929.
         Page: https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/45434
         File: https://images.metmuseum.org/CRDImages/as/original/DP130155.jpg
         sha256 cbb9988f2f18b9180a1cc0cf5dbb0e3bbf8f2e85d17930cf6ca9ab36fac36303
         Licence: public domain; The Met's Open Access image, CC0 1.0
         (the Met's collection API marks the work isPublicDomain).
  2.qoi  "Ara ararauna portrait Rhodes" (a blue-and-yellow macaw), by Jebulon.
         Page: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Ara_ararauna_portrait_Rhodes.jpg
         File: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/4/45/Ara_ararauna_portrait_Rhodes.jpg
         sha256 9b6ed98b5e40378373b9297ab80cec8a8365a78171ef2e769dfb31c5d6c73367
         Licence: CC0 1.0, the author's own work (LICENSE-CC0-1.0.txt).
  3.qoi  "Sunflowers", Vincent van Gogh, 1887; The Metropolitan Museum of
         Art, 49.41, Rogers Fund, 1949.
         Page: https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/436524
         File: https://images.metmuseum.org/CRDImages/ep/original/DP-41223-001.jpg
         sha256 ba7160774025633fab2891c33840d8316af28e5c1eba8f79a48115a065391f3c
         Licence: public domain; The Met's Open Access image, CC0 1.0
         (the Met's collection API marks the work isPublicDomain).
  4.qoi  "View of the Earth seen by the Apollo 17 crew traveling toward the
         moon" (The Blue Marble), NASA, Apollo 17 crew, 1972-12-07; AS17-148-22727.
         Page: https://images.nasa.gov/details/as17-148-22727
         File: https://images-assets.nasa.gov/image/as17-148-22727/as17-148-22727~orig.jpg
         sha256 cb4c3d2da98ee72130ebfd2ea472fc84ede6726002c2a8c9cabd86e4deea9f0f
         Licence: public domain. NASA's Images and Media Usage Guidelines
         (https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/): NASA
         images "generally are not subject to copyright in the United
         States". Wikimedia Commons tags it PD-USGov-NASA
         (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:The_Earth_seen_from_Apollo_17.jpg).
  5.qoi  "Chania lighthouse Crete Greece", by Jebulon.
         Page: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Chania_lighthouse_Crete_Greece.jpg
         File: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/4/4e/Chania_lighthouse_Crete_Greece.jpg
         sha256 a5a4f69b1180c2d25ee33b66b6a9237e6aa314ff70743ab962aeb6864cacc9eb
         Licence: CC0 1.0, the author's own work (LICENSE-CC0-1.0.txt).
